final.paragraph:
This is an automated hazard-exposure briefing produced by Riprap from live and baked data sources. It is informational only and not a substitute for a professional risk assessment.

**Answer.**
The block around 90-01 183rd Street, Queens, was recorded to have a Hurricane Ida high-water mark within 800 meters, with the highest observed water elevation at 48.2 feet [ida_hwm].

**Hazard Reader.**
This address sits outside the empirical 2012 Hurricane Sandy inundation footprint (NYC OEM) [sandy_inundation]. This address sits in FEMA flood zone X, per NFHL FIRM panel 3604970234F, effective 2007 [fema_nfhl]. This address is outside the modeled flooding in the NYC DEP stormwater scenario (2.13 in/hr, 2050 SLR) [dep_moderate_2050].

**Out of scope.** This briefing does not assess title, structural condition, or compliance with specific zoning rules. Where a probe was offline at run time, the relevant section omits that signal.
